_note: Canonical NoöPunk core resolution data for issue #111. NoöPunk is an independent RPG system inspired by multiple games; no single external ruleset is its mechanical parent.
_source_of_truth: RULEBOOK.md and explicit current author direction.

stats._note: The six base STATs are locked by explicit author direction on issue #131 (2026-10-05): FIT / REF / INT / SOC / CYB / PSY. They remain the universal 1..10 character attributes. Cybernetic hardware statistics (COMPUTE / INTERFACE / NETWORK and similar) are properties of decks, implants, devices and agents, NOT character STATs. Deeper social and psychic complexity lives in the Social Systems and Psychic Systems layers, not in more base attributes.

skills._note: Issue #159 defines the canonical universal Skill list in data/rules/skills.json, superseding the earlier 'deferred' state. Every Skill ties to one of the six STATs; see rulebook/9_SKILLS.md.

probability_examples._note: Success rates for representative fixed STAT+Skill profiles before modifiers; recorded for playtesting, not used to alter the authored DVs.
